DepthFM (CompVis, LMU Munich): relative depth from one image by flow matching on a Stable Diffusion UNet, in two steps. MIT code; OpenRAIL weights (commercially usable with use restrictions).

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Original code: https://github.com/CompVis/depth-fm at da632c8
  • Code licence: MIT (permissive); files: LICENSE, LICENSE-MODEL, LICENSE-VAE
  • Weights licence: LicenseRef-CreativeML-OpenRAIL-PlusPlus-M AND LicenseRef-CreativeML-OpenRAIL-M
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/CompVis/depth-fm/blob/da632c8118e41cc64ca191a13314e2db1a7722d9/README.md (fine-tuned from Stable Diffusion v2-1; code MIT); SD2 licence text from https://huggingface.co/sd2-community/stable-diffusion-2/blob/2511124fabf8bf30c0ca9dccd9729e7f0f2fa669/LICENSE-MODEL, SD1.5 VAE licence https://github.com/CompVis/stable-diffusion/blob/21f890f9da3cfbeaba8e2ac3c425ee9e998d5229/LICENSE
  • Training data: Stable Diffusion 2.1 (LAION-5B subsets) fine-tuned on the synthetic Hypersim and Virtual KITTI 2 datasets per the DepthFM paper (arXiv 2403.13788)
  • Licence note: The UNet is fine-tuned from Stable Diffusion 2.1 (OpenRAIL++-M) and runs with the Stable Diffusion 1.5 VAE (OpenRAIL-M): commercial use is allowed but with use restrictions that must be passed on; the training data terms are not checked.
  • Options: steps = 2 (1 to 1000; also num_steps), ensemble = 4 (>= 1; also ensemble_size), long_side = 0 (>= 0; also processing_res), seed = 2024
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc
  • Variants: depthfm-v1
  • Outputs: depth; kind: affine_invariant
  • Input size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): depthfm-v1 1024x1024 (9.8 GiB peak allocated, 15.0 reserved)
  • depthfm-v1 994x1482, first call: portable + torch.compile 102 s (cold Inductor cache).
  • depthfm-v1 portable 994x1482: Default four-member ensemble with bounded VAE decoding. Prior portable was 5814.353 ms and 13671 MiB peak allocated. Relative AbsRel changes were below 0.000002 on three matched Middlebury inputs.
  • depthfm-v1 kernels 994x1482: Default four-member ensemble with bounded VAE decoding. Prior kernels was 3578.895 ms and 9258 MiB peak allocated. Relative AbsRel changes were below 0.000002 on three matched Middlebury inputs.
  • depthfm-v1 portable 480x640: Portable timing measured separately at the TensorRT comparison's input shape, precision and fixed-shape exported depth network scope.
  • depthfm-v1 load / first call: portable 3.58 s / 6.004 s, kernels 4.59 s / 3.734 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

Aligned depth scores fit scale and shift by least squares, in disparity space for inverse-depth models. Metric depth scores follow each dataset's protocol. Both average over images. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.0001 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 1 % and p99 <= 3 % of the reference's median |value| (absolute error of the output depth).

Limitations

  • Flow model on a noised latent: the seeded noise comes from a CPU generator and differs from the original code's device generator for the same seed.
  • A traced or exported module reuses the noise of its traced shape.
  • The network input sides are rounded to multiples of 64, so the aspect ratio changes slightly.
